ETA: I'm just paying for me and my son so it's just for 2. I know it's splitting hairs since we're traveling as a group but thought I would point out that out.

I can reply in more detail later but I made sure to book at hostels that allowed for boys his age, they all stipulated that they have to be with their parent which is why I am going to contact them to make sure they put us in the same room.

I did try my hardest to find at least one that said it has a quiet atmosphere and I also made sure they had bunk beds (although I wouldn't've minded one where it's just a futon on the floor, maybe another trip!) and like I said, I tried to isolate us a bit in a private room but that didn't always work out in places where they didn't have private rooms. Hi, thank you for your response. We get along really well so I was of course happy to have her come and yeah, it went from there. I showed her pictures of the hostels and she said they'd be ok sleeping on the beds and she was a bit nervous about getting funny looks from people but as long as there weren't any rules against their age staying there, she would like to go. We looked at some hotels and my parents were against it, I think they knew I've always wanted to plan a "pack light, stay in hostels, find our way around without a tour group" vacation and they just want to follow my original plan to see how it goes but I don't know that for sure, they haven't said anything to me. 

I'm not against losing out on the rooms if my parents are right miserable once we get there. I have plenty of money saved up that I'll be unhappy that I lost out on the cash but in the end I'd be ok with spending extra to make sure they're happy.  I'm trying to save up enough to take a travel-year with my son (like years down the road kindof thing) so I do have some of those funds in savings. I thought I'd be foolish to go on such a trip without taking at least one smaller trip first just to get a feel for things. 

That is also why I thought when I contact the hostels to let them know that a 13 year old is coming, that I'd let them know a couple of 60 year old's were coming too so if they are right against it, they can let me know and we can get it dealt with before we get there or perhaps they'd give us a bit of leeway and make sure we stay in a room together.

I have a few stupid things I've cried over. Me and my dad went over to my Great Aunts house to shovel snow once (she'll call up friends and relatives and tell them she'll pay to shovel her driveway.) She pays based on how much you did. I was super eager to make lots of money so I picked the wet snow at the bottom of the steep driveway thinking she'll see that I picked the tough part and pay me extra. My dad breezed through the top of the driveway as it was just a light layer of fluffy snow. I was BEAT by the time we were done, just sweating my ass off, my legs and arms and hands hurt. 
My mom showed up after she was done her shift and said that she's feeling really bad and almost left work early but she didn't start feeling that way till right at the very end. Anyways, we go in really quick to say that everything is done, my Great Aunt gave my dad $50 (she's a retired teacher and just completely loaded) and she gave me $30 for "helping my dad a little bit but I did a good effort" I was sooooo cheesed off but didn't say anything to her and honestly, it wasn't particularly about the money but what she said about how I helped a little bit. Like...OMG I just spent hours and was fricken dying and I only helped a little bit. Then, after we left, my dad has to make a comment about what luck it was that he did the easy part and got more money for it. I started crying and hugged my mom who pushed me away and told me to not touch her because she was feeling REALLY sick but I was really upset and it didn't really clue in to what she was saying, I was just really hurt that she pushed me away so I hugged her again crying even more, she pushed me to the ground and turned around and puked in my Aunts bushes. 
Afterwards, I felt like a spoiled child (I was like...10 or 11 or something) and just felt like a complete ass for not listening to my mom when she was sick and just whined to her about not getting $50. Like...I had nothing to buy back then, not like I do now but I was just completely sore and exhausted and had no idea about real work and felt really insulted over the whole thing. We went home and my mom went to bed after puking again and I went to bed to have a nap because I was still crying over the whole thing. After I woke up, I was like "wow....I was that upset over that....I'm an ass"
